We need to propose a retrosynthesis route to target molecule SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

We have applied template 20810 and got precursors: ('CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1', 'O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F')

So disconnection: target = sulfonamide formed from aryl sulfonyl chloride (Cl-SO2-aryl-F) and an aniline derivative (the other fragment). The template suggests sulfonamide formation via nucleophilic substitution of sulfonyl chloride with an amine.

Thus step 1: combine sulfonyl chloride (4-fluorophenyl sulfonyl chloride) with amine (the heterocycle). So we need to get these two precursors as commercially available.

Check if both are buyable. Use is_buyable.
